description: ignorePaths: the list of config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests preset (node_modules, bower_components, vendor, examples, __tests__, test, tests, __fixtures__), restated because setting ignorePaths replaces it, plus **/testdata/** and **/third_party/**. Those two hold fixtures copied verbatim from upstream (build: BuildKit Dockerfiles whose FROM lines the parser tests compare against; shell: a vendored mvdan-sh tree) and test programs compiled to wasm; bumping them rewrites expected outputs or a vendored copy, and the dashboards listed them as 'updates' (build#7/#8, shell#5, compose's localhost:5000/db lookup failure). A repository that needs one of them updated sets its own ignorePaths.

One pull request per repository for everything non-breaking, rather than one per dependency. Merging them singly means every merge rebases the others and restarts their checks: one run over an organisation of 34 repositories updated 109 branches and merged 2. Grouped, a repository needs one round of checks instead of dozens.

Never auto-merge the Go toolchain, and never let it ride in somebody else's group. A rule that says automerge:false for one dependency is defeated by grouping, because Renovate decides automerge per BRANCH: go 1.27.0 rode into seven repositories inside a branch called renovate/github-actions, whose other dependency was actions/setup-go. Ungrouped, it gets a branch of its own and this setting governs it. It matters because go1.27.0 miscompiles on loong64 (golang/go#81000, bisected on real hardware to 3fdac6780b): go-gfx/gfx fails that lane and stayed open only because the lane failed, which is the CI gate holding rather than this rule. A repository without such a lane sees nothing.

playwright-go v0.6100.0 and later cannot be required: their go.mod declares the module path github.com/mxschmitt/playwright-go, so `go get`/`go mod tidy` fail with 'module declares its path as: github.com/mxschmitt/playwright-go but was required as: github.com/playwright-community/playwright-go' (reproduced 2026-10-29 on v0.6100.0, v0.6201.0 and v0.6201.1; v0.6000.0 resolves). Renovate nevertheless proposed v0.6201.1 in gpu, dashboard, relay and playground, and each of those branches failed with 'renovate/artifacts: Artifact file update failure' and a red build. Cap the version until upstream fixes the path; lift this rule when a newer release resolves.
